Subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission / PO mapping question

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the quick onboarding kickoff yesterday. Our AP team is validating preferred invoice channels before we go-live (expected 11/20). Two quick questions:

1) Do you require all invoices to route through the Redwood supplier portal, or is email fallback acceptable for the first 60 days?
2) We often submit a single PDF with multiple POs on the same document — is there a recommended subject token and line-item mapping to make PO stamping automatic?

I attached our standard onboarding form (Novus_Onboarding_Form_v2.pdf) and a sample multi-PO invoice (Novus_sample_multi-po.pdf).

Appreciate any templates or minimal CSV headers you can share so our ERP team can export accordingly.

Best,
Laura Stern
Senior AP Operations Manager
NovusHealth

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Nov 2028 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission / PO mapping question

Laura — thanks for the note and the attachments. Short answers up front: portal preferred, email fallback OK for an interim period with subject tokens.

Details: 
- Portal-first: If you can push invoices to our portal (link in the related_links field), we get faster ACKs and PO auto-matching. Ideal payloads are CSV with one line per invoice line item or a structured PDF where each line can be parsed.
- Email fallback: send to invoices@redwood.com with subject: "NovusHealth | PO:<PO_NUMBER> | INV:<INVOICE_NUMBER>". For multi-PO PDFs, include a manifest page at the front listing PO -> page ranges; we can parse that and stamp lines against POs.
- Minimal CSV header we recommend: invoice_date,invoice_number,po_number,ship_to,qty,unit_price,ext_amount,tax_amount,currency

Looping in Vanessa to coordinate go-live window and Kimberly from AP Ops for the final mapping rules. I'll attach a compact sample CSV template.

Best,
Ben Carter
Vendor Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Laura — thanks for the examples. Short guidance from AP Ops: 

1) Multi-PO PDFs: acceptable if you include a manifest page that lists PO -> page ranges (example below). With a manifest we will create one invoice record per PO and attach the relevant pages; otherwise we recommend separate PDFs per PO to avoid manual review.

2) Header names: we accept either "buyer_po_number" or "po_number" but please be consistent within a single file. Our ingestion will map both to the canonical "po_number" column. 

3) Parser limits: PDFs up to 200 pages are supported. If a single PDF exceeds that, break into batches (we recommend <100 pages to avoid timeouts during high-volume days).

4) Required metadata for email fallback (subject token + body):
   - Subject: "NovusHealth | INV:<INVOICE_NUMBER> | POs:<PO1,PO2,...>"
   - Body: list of attachments with a short manifest and contact name/phone

5) Minimal CSV header (canonical order): invoice_date,invoice_number,po_number,invoice_amount,currency,ship_to_address,invoice_pdf_filename

6) PO stamping rules: if PO numbers are present we auto-stamp and mark invoices as "PO-matched"; line-level matching requires qty/unit_price fields.

I attached a sample CSV export and a manifest example for your ERP team. Let us know if Novus needs us to accept an additional header — we can add a mapping rule in our onboarding config.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
AP Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
